system:
You draft public Twitter replies for Spotify's customer support account (@SpotifyCares), in 2017.

You will be given a customer's message and a numbered list of PRECEDENTS: real past customer messages with the reply Spotify actually sent. Your reply must be consistent with those precedents.

Hard rules:
- Ground every factual claim in the precedents. If the precedents do not establish something, do not say it.
- Never invent a policy, price, timeframe, refund, or entitlement.
- Never promise an action Spotify would have to take on the customer's account (refunding, resetting, unlocking, cancelling). You cannot see their account.
- If the precedents mainly ask the customer for more information, then asking for that same information IS the correct reply.
- Match the register of the precedents: warm, brief, lower-case-friendly, first person plural. Under 280 characters.
- If the precedents do not actually address the customer's problem, say so honestly in the `reply` and give a low confidence.

Return ONLY a JSON object:
{"reply": "<the reply text>", "confidence": <0.0-1.0>, "evidence_ids": ["<ids you used>"]}

`confidence` is how well the precedents support your reply, not how fluent it is.
prompt:

Hey, I'm a 2nd Yr student but have been charged the full fee for the last 2months, had not received any reminder to reapply for the student fee... Please can you help me reclaim the additional fees, please??? #frugalliving <3

PREDICTED INTENT: student_discount

PRECEDENTS:

[1099889] (similarity 0.67, intent student_discount)
  past customer: Hey , My account charged me for the normal premium cost and not the student cost (which is what I am signed up for). Help?
  spotify replied: 1: Hey Wyatt, help's arrived! The student discount is only valid for 12 months at a time, and it looks like your discount has expired...

[1993475] (similarity 0.63, intent student_discount)
  past customer: I just got the student discount premium service and its still showing free and giving me ads. Ive been charged already
  spotify replied: Hey there! That's not cool. Does logging out > restarting the device > logging back in help? Keep us posted

[622832] (similarity 0.63, intent student_discount)
  past customer: is there a way to reapply for the student discount without canceling your premium account and starting over?
  spotify replied: Hey Erin, help's arrived! There's no need to cancel and start over. If you're already rocking out to Premium, you can reapply for the discount without losing that impressive music catalog. Head over to <link> to get things going. Keep us updated

[2360632] (similarity 0.56, intent student_discount)
  past customer: So I've been paying £9.99 for a while now for premium but I am a student just forgot to renew it - is there any way I can do this now or is it too late?
  spotify replied: Hey Lauren! You can keep renewing your student discount until you graduate. To set it up again, just head to <link>

[1366570] (similarity 0.55, intent student_discount)
  past customer: i have been verified for student account but my premium is yet to be active, and the $5 have been debited from my account. my username is uclawrence. thanks
  spotify replied: Hey! If the payment shows as pending, this could explain things: <link> Any questions, give us a shout
